title: Attract engineers
goal: Engineers find us and build one complete profile
actors: Mark: posts, communities and the referral loop bring engineers in | Desi: a sign-up and profile flow that converts | Bui: profile, demo matching without signup, funnel events

title: Vet engineers
goal: Only engineers US teams would hire reach the deck
actors: Mark: vetting pipeline, rubric and interview scorecard | Founder: live interviews and meetups as community lead | Bui: verification status and badge, once the definition is decided | Rev: no 'vetted' claim until the founder defines it

title: Win hiring teams
goal: US startups that hire globally say yes to a pilot
actors: Selly: finds US startups hiring globally and drafts openers | Rev: checks every claim before it leaves | Founder: sends by hand and runs discovery calls | Avi: challenges the niche and the price

title: Run the pilot
goal: A first mutual match within 7 days
actors: Selly: 7-day onboarding plan per pilot | Founder: onboards each pilot personally | Bui: role details, like notifications, per-pilot funnel | Desi: hiring-team pipeline UX

title: Match and hire
goal: Both sides choose; the conversation turns into a hire
actors: Bui: mutual match, explained fit, salary up front, chat and scheduling | Founder: watches each pilot and unblocks | Rev: privacy and data checks (no exact location or salary leaks)

title: Get paid
goal: Pilots convert to the per-hire fee
actors: Selly: pilot-to-paid proposal | Founder: sets the fee and signs | Rev: checks pricing claims | Avi: default-alive math

title: Prove and tell
actors: Founder: logs metrics every week | Mark: case studies and posts on real results | Desi: case-study visuals | Rev: every number traced to docs/metrics.md

title: Raise and exit
goal: Money to grow and a second bidder in the room
actors: Rizer: deck, US investors, acquirer map, data room | Rev: checks every deck claim | Avi: hard questions; back, challenge or kill | Founder: pitches and decides
output: Rounds closed, then a LinkedIn LOI
